ops.body: Superseded — closing. The v8 criterion ("each repo pins cc-transcript>=8,<9") is obsolete: the family moved past v8 deliberately, and the 2026-07-11 follow-ups round landed every repo on cc-transcript 11.0.0 with suites green: captain-hook c55fd5fc (pin >=11,<12; AttachmentEvent migration; 2703 pytest + 227 capt-hook tests + pyright clean), cc-steer 099ce04 (pin >=11,<12; zero drift; 275 tests; 5 pre-existing collection errors tracked separately as task 6a39a0c4 — cc_transcript.mining.sampling never shipped), cc-context/bench b043045 (pin >=11,<12; dropped the unused capt-hook dep that made >=11 unsatisfiable; 158 tests). cc-sentiment intentionally waits for the v12 lexicon redesign and migrates once, straight to >=12,<13.
